# Gnomad Promotions — Customize Promotional Products

> Gnomad Promotions (customizepromotionalproducts.com) sells custom promotional products, branded apparel, drinkware, bags, awards, tech gifts and corporate gifts decorated with a customer's logo. Free virtual proofs, free art help, rush options, nationwide shipping from the Dallas–Fort Worth area. Phone 972-476-0353, email sales@gnomadpromotions.com. Live catalog: https://www.promoplace.com/gnomad-promotions
